verdict.rationale: Gazebo is a robotics simulator for building/testing robots and environments; the story asks about teleoperating a physical remote robot with live video over real-world networks, which is a live robot-operations capability outside Gazebo's simulation-tool category. Evidence about TCP/IP transport and remote servers ([gazebo-gh-6],[gazebo-gh-9]) refers to running simulation instances remotely, not real-world robot teleoperation, so it does not flip this to an applicable axis.
